description: SKELETON ONLY: every element is listed with an "unmatched" target so the mapping work is visible. No LOINC/SNOMED target has been guessed. Fill in `target` after terminology review.

element.display: Died at the reporting hospital without receiving any treatment there (diagnosed here and died or discharged critically ill, or diagnosed elsewhere and transferred here before dying)

The entire first course of therapy was given at the reporting hospital, with none at another hospital (includes a case whose only first-course therapy is one of the registry's defined "other treatments")

No first-course therapy at the reporting hospital: the whole first course was given elsewhere, or the case came for a second opinion with no treatment here, or the main treatment plan was set by another hospital (e.g. maintenance therapy continued here, or a referred-out partial radiotherapy course)
Part of the first course of therapy at the reporting hospital, part at another hospital
The first course of therapy was watchful observation, or only non-tumour-directed palliative surgery, pain control, supportive care, or a hospice referral
The first course of therapy was alternative therapy only
The patient refused treatment in the first course
Diagnosed and treated elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital because of a complication of the cancer or its treatment
Diagnosed elsewhere; presented at the reporting hospital for an unrelated condition -- not reportable
First-course treatment status unknown, and refusal cannot be confirmed either (e.g. lost to follow-up after the initial diagnosis at the reporting hospital)
